content: Northstar Home sells space-saving home organization products through online marketplaces and operates a catalog of more than 80 products.
Northstar Home announced plans to expand cross-border fulfillment and grow marketplace sales in North America.
GreenPaw Goods develops sustainable pet accessories and has an established direct-to-consumer business in the United Kingdom.
GreenPaw Goods is hiring an e-commerce operations specialist to support international marketplace expansion.
GlowNest Beauty sells cosmetic accessories and emphasizes product design, quality control, and retail partnerships.
GlowNest Beauty shared a seasonal product promotion with its customer community.
FlexTrail Fitness offers compact training accessories and has grown its online product catalog across several Asian markets.
FlexTrail Fitness reported increased online demand and is evaluating new marketplace partnerships.
